instruction.text: How many balloons are there? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: ssml: How many balloons can you see? Count them and select the correct number.

instruction.text: Two balloons have burst! How many balloons are left?
instruction.sound: ssml: Oh no, two balloons have burst. How many are left?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly, because five<break time='100ms'/> minus two<break time='100ms'/> equals three.

instruction.text: How many apples are there? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: How many apples can you see? Count them and select the correct number.

instruction.text: How many apples are left? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>person_biting_into_apple</voice> Some apples have been eaten. How many are left?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly, because six<break time='100ms'/> minus three<break time='100ms'/> equals three.

instruction.text: How many eggs are there? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: How many eggs are there? Select the correct number.

instruction.text: How many eggs are left? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>egg-smash</voice> Oh dear, some eggs were broken. How many are left? Count them up.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly, because seven<break time='100ms'/> minus three<break time='100ms'/> equals four.

instruction.text: How many full glasses are there? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>pouring water</voice> How many full glasses of water are there? Count them.

instruction.text: How many full glasses are left? Select the correct number.
instruction.sound: Now the water from four of the glasses has been drunk. How many full glasses of water are left?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly. Because five<break time='100ms'/> minus four<break time='100ms'/> equals  one. Great job!
